SELECT hs.id AS id, hs.name AS name, hs.yb_no AS mdtrtCertNo, hs.bus_no AS businessCode, cid.price_value AS amount, hs.active_flag AS status FROM adm_healthcare_service hs LEFT JOIN adm_charge_item_definition cid ON cid.instance_table = 'adm_healthcare_service' AND cid.instance_id = hs.id AND cid.type_code = '1012' AND cid.is_deleted = 0 WHERE hs.is_deleted = 0 AND hs.category_code = 'REGISTRATION'
AND (hs.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR hs.yb_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR hs.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY hs.created_at DESC
